title: New names for the npm tools
summary:
The npm tools got new names, and the docs got a clearer first request, video options, and API error examples.

The SDK, MCP package, and oh-my-pollicode were renamed to `@pollinations_ai/sdk`, `@pollinations_ai/model-context-protocol`, and `@pollinations_ai/oh-my-pollicode`. Installation examples and the MCP installer were updated to match; the SDK’s functionality did not change.

A community contribution added a three-step README quick start: get an API key, choose image, text, audio, or video generation, then follow an existing example.

Community docs now specify video duration ranges and defaults for `seedance` and `veo`, along with their supported input types. Examples for four common API errors were also added, though a formatting issue leaves some of those entries inside a code block.
